Wilcoxon tests compare each cluster with the other cells. Seurat uses Bonferroni-adjusted marker p-values. These are exploratory cluster markers, not donor-level disease tests.

Methods and interpretation

RNA counts are retained. LogNormalize and VST precede variable-gene scaling, PCA, graph neighbors, Louvain clustering and R-native uwot UMAP.

Automatic labels use a documented marker-panel heuristic, not a probability. NKG7 and PRF1 alone do not distinguish NK from cytotoxic T cells. Review CD3D, CD3E and TRAC alongside GNLY and KLRD1.

Reactome over-representation uses each cluster's tested-gene universe and BH correction across every eligible pathway, including zero-overlap pathways.

The one-donor PBMC3k demo cannot support a disease/control comparison. Donor-level DESeq2 is a separate extension requiring independent donors and reviewed labels. FASTQ alignment, empty-droplet calling and full ambient-RNA estimation are outside this executed count-matrix demo.

Configuration

list(project = "pbmc3k", seed = 42L, output_dir = "results/pbmc3k", 
    input = list(mode = "demo", samples = "config/samples.csv"), 
    qc = list(min_genes = 200L, max_genes = 2500L, max_pct_mt = 5, 
        min_cells_per_gene = 3L, mitochondrial_pattern = "^MT-", 
        overrides = list()), doublets = list(enabled = TRUE, 
        remove = TRUE, expected_rate = 0.04), normalization = list(
        scale_factor = 10000, n_hvg = 2000L), embedding = list(
        n_pcs = 30L, dims = 1:20, k = 20L, resolution = 0.5, 
        integration = "none", batch_key = "batch"), markers = list(
        min_pct = 0.1, min_log2fc = 0.25, max_adjusted_p = 0.05), 
    annotation = list(panel = "config/markers.R", manual_labels = NULL, 
        min_score = 0.25, min_margin = 0.1), enrichment = list(
        gmt = "resources/reactome_2022.gmt", min_size = 5L, max_size = 500L, 
        top_genes = 200L))
